hooks.name: mod_event
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge has no mod-to-mod event bus)

rust_summary: an event one server-side Lua mod emitted for the others (`native_mod_event`: the event's `<mod>:<name>` and its payload), delivered at the end of the tick, and the helper that queues one (`native_emit`).
doc_summary: `native_mod_event(event, payload)` once for each event a server-side Lua mod queued with `horizon.emit(event, payload)`, at the end of the tick it emitted in: `event` is the emitting mod's own name for it (`<mod>:<name>`) and `payload` the emit's table, decoded fresh for the listener; a listener's answer carries nowhere. Any mod may listen to any mod's event; `horizon.on_event("<mod>:<name>", fn)` registers a handler of one. A listener that emits queues for the same drain, and an emit past the tick's depth cap drops. Bundles need "hooks": @API:mod_events@.
